text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: —Ooooooohhhh!!!!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: —Haaaaaaahhh!!!!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Oguri Cap refuses to lose!! Bamboo Memory 
won't give an inch!! Will it be Oguri?! Or 
Bamboo?!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
(Blaze...! Blaze, burn, burn, buuurn! 
Everything I have, right here, right 
now—!)

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Blaze uuuuuuup!!!!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Bamboo Memory takes the lead!! It's Bamboo 
Memory!! Bamboo Memoryyy!!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
“—Crosses the finish line!!! It's Bamboo 
Memory!! The champion of the mile is 
Bamboo Memory!!!”
(WOOOOOOOOOOOAAAHH!!!!)

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Oooooh!! What was that race?! I legit got 
goosebumps! Bamboo Memory is incredible!!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
To think there's an Umamusume who can beat 
Oguri when she's in top form...!!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
—Truly magnificent. That was a 
soul-stirring run.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Seriously...! It was so heated and 
thrilling, it made me think, 'I want to 
race like that too!' It was an amazing 
race!!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Destroying what was preordained, perhaps 
today... marks the dawn of an uncharted 
era—

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
"Congratulations from the bottom of my 
heart, Bamboo-san...!"
(WOOOOOOOOOOOAAAHH!!!!)

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: ......That's totally awesome.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: —Bamboo.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Oguri-senpai...

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: ...It was the greatest race.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
"Let's run again. And next time, we'll put 
on an even better race than today."

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
I'm going to beat you in that race. 
That's—

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: It's my "dream" right now.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: ...Oguri-senpai!!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
"Someday, I want to run a race even better 
than today's!! No, let's make it happen 
together, sir!!!"

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Yeah. I'm counting on you.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Heheh—

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Trainer-saaaan!!!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Thank you so very much!!! Really, truly, 
honestly, genuinely!! Thank you so 
much!!!!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: My "dream"... It really did come true!!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
But it's not over yet, sir!! No matter how 
many times it takes...!! The "dream" goes 
on!!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: So... that's why—!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Yes, sir!! I'll be in your care!!!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Alright then, to celebrate this moment, 
let's do our usual in grand style!!!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Bamboooooooooooooooo!! 
Memoryyyyyyyyyyyyyyyy!!!

And so, Bamboo Memory brilliantly claimed 
the throne of her generation's Mile 
Champion—
A brief moment of time passed—

text_block_list.name: Announcer
text_block_list.text:
"—Here's the Twinkle Series Trending News! 
This week's biggest highlight is 
undoubtedly this! Dominating all the 
chatter, it's the fierce battle at the 
Mile CS!!"

text_block_list.name: Announcer
text_block_list.text:
"That truly was a legendary race!! Of 
course, last year's fierce battle with 
Tamamo Cross and the recent clash between 
the Eternal Big Three were incredible as 
well, but—"

text_block_list.name: Announcer
text_block_list.text:
"It feels as if we were shown that Bamboo 
Memory rules the mile!"

text_block_list.name: Announcer
text_block_list.text:
“I'm sure that to Oguri as well, Bamboo 
proved to be an immensely formidable 
presence!”

text_block_list.name: Commentator
text_block_list.text:
"I was still riding the post-race high 
myself, so I ended up gushing about it 
passionately to my daughter. She's still 
just a young horse girl, but—"

text_block_list.name: Commentator
text_block_list.text:
"She told me that she wanted to run in a 
race like that, too. Ah, the sparkle in 
her eyes... She gave me such a wonderful 
dream."

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: A dream...

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Heheh— Thank goodness. ...What a relief!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
“Still, we're only getting started! Our 
era, our "dream"!! It's gonna burn way, 
way hotter!!!”

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
And! Time and time again!! We're gonna 
create the absolute greatest rivalries!!!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
UWOOOOOOAH!! Just saying that got me all 
fired uuuppp!!!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: ...Trainer!!!
choice_data_list: Alright, shall we head to training!!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Yes, sir!!!

"Towards an unseen fiery future and 
thrilling showdowns, I dash off alongside 
Bamboo Memory again today—!"
